001package org.clafer.domain;
002
003/**
004 * Boolean domain. 0 encodes false and 1 encodes true.
005 *
006 * @author jimmy
007 */
008public class BoolDomain extends Domain {
009
010    public static final BoolDomain TrueDomain = new BoolDomain(true, false);
011    public static final BoolDomain FalseDomain = new BoolDomain(false, true);
012    public static final BoolDomain TrueFalseDomain = new BoolDomain(true, true);
013
014    private BoolDomain(boolean hasTrue, boolean hasFalse) {
015        super(hasFalse ? 0 : 1, hasTrue ? 2 : 1);
016    }
017
018    public BoolDomain invert() {
019        if (isTrue()) {
020            return FalseDomain;
021        }
022        return isFalse() ? TrueDomain : TrueFalseDomain;
023    }
024
025    public boolean isTrue() {
026        return bounds[0] == 1;
027    }
028
029    public boolean isFalse() {
030        return bounds[1] == 1;
031    }
032
033    public boolean isUnknown() {
034        return !isTrue() && !isFalse();
035    }
036}
